name: PublicationMoratorium
summary: The card component of Publication Moratorium (DUO_0000024). The requester accepted the terms document the owner requires, and a compute environment attests that it handles results securely. Decides about the requester.

requiredDocumentID.description: Identifier of the terms document the requester must have accepted; compared for equality with AgreementCredential.agreementInfo.documentID. If the key is missing, nothing qualifies and access is denied.
